description: This file contains implementation of helper classes and functions for engine testing, including methods to simulate trigger events, manage time, and verify event scheduling in a vehicle engine control system.

classes.name: EngineTestHelperBase
classes.description: Base class providing basic engine test helper functionalities.

classes.name: EngineTestHelper
classes.description: Derived class offering comprehensive engine testing utilities, including trigger event simulation, time management, and event verification.

methods.name: EngineTestHelperBase
methods.description: Constructor initializing base helper, currently resets global time variable.

methods.name: EngineTestHelper
methods.description: Constructor initializing engine test helper with specific engine type, setting up engine configuration, sensors, and trigger shape.

methods.name: fireRise
methods.description: Simulates a trigger rise event after a specified delay.

methods.name: firePrimaryTriggerRise
methods.description: Triggers a primary trigger rise event.

methods.name: fireFall
methods.description: Simulates a trigger fall event after a specified delay.

methods.name: firePrimaryTriggerFall
methods.description: Triggers a primary trigger fall event.

methods.name: fireTriggerEventsWithDuration
methods.description: Fires a sequence of trigger rise and fall events with specified duration.

methods.name: fireTriggerEvents2
methods.description: Fires a specified number of rise/fall trigger events with a given interval.

methods.name: clearQueue
methods.description: Clears scheduled events and resets internal queue state.

methods.name: executeActions
methods.description: Executes all scheduled engine actions.

methods.name: moveTimeForwardMs
methods.description: Advances internal time by specified milliseconds.

methods.name: moveTimeForwardUs
methods.description: Advances internal time by specified microseconds.

methods.name: getTimeNowUs
methods.description: Returns current simulated time in microseconds.

methods.name: fireTriggerEvents
methods.description: Fires a set number of trigger events with default interval.

methods.name: assertInjectorUpEvent
methods.description: Verifies an injector up event at a specific time.

methods.name: assertInjectorDownEvent
methods.description: Verifies an injector down event at a specific time.

methods.name: assertEvent5
methods.description: Verifies an event at a specific index with expected callback and timing.

methods.name: assertEvent
methods.description: Verifies an event's callback, timing, and parameters.

methods.name: applyTriggerShape
methods.description: Initializes trigger shape in the engine.

methods.name: assertRpm
methods.description: Checks if the engine RPM matches expected value.

methods.description: Configures a simple engine test environment with MAF sensor and specified trigger.

methods.name: setupSimpleTestEngineWithMafAndTT_ONE_trigger
methods.description: Configures engine test with MAF sensor and TT_ONE trigger.
